app.name: Plant care
app.summary: Shows when a plant was last watered and fed, and a tap on the screen says done today.
app.tile_example: Monstera: watered 3 d ago, fed 12 d ago
app.what_hint: Shown at the top of the tile, such as Monstera.
app.water_every_hint: After this many days the dot turns amber, and red a while later.
app.fert_every_hint: After this many days the dot turns amber, and red a while later.
